card.name: Second digit of low vital-sign cutoffs
card.fires_on: The last digit of a two-digit threshold number after "less than" or "<", in lab or vital-sign cutoffs such as heart rate, oxygen saturation or ejection fraction. It also fires once inside "hypotension".

modes.label: Heart rate cutoffs
modes.description: Final digit of a bradycardia heart-rate limit such as 50 or 60 bpm.

modes.label: Other low-value cutoffs
modes.description: Final digit of a low oxygen saturation or LVEF limit.
modes.example: Left Ventricular Dysfunction LVEF < 4<<5>>% Do not administer KADCYLA

modes.label: Hypotension word
modes.description: The middle piece of "hypotension" in dosing text.

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a low-value cutoff, like heart rate under 50, in warnings and dosing instructions.
